name: Post Matric Scholarship Scheme for Scheduled Tribe students - Tamil Nadu
provider: Tribal Welfare Department, Government of Tamil Nadu (centrally sponsored 75:25)

rules.quote: To encourage higher education among tribal students, scholarships under the Post Matric Scholarship Scheme are provided to students pursuing higher education after completing the 10th Standard.
This scholarship is available to students whose parents or guardians have an annual income not exceeding Rs.2.50 lakh.
Tribal students studying above the 10th Standard in Government and Government-Aided Educational Institutions receive the Government-prescribed tuition fee

amount.text: Tuition fee plus maintenance allowance per month: Group I Rs 1,200 (hosteller)/550 (day scholar); II 820/530; III 570/300; IV 380/230
amount.quote: Under this scheme, Tuition Fees and Maintenance Allowance are provided as scholarships.

deadline.text: Not stated; applications via UMIS portal (umisdashboard.tnega.org)
